capability.summary: Estimate aggregate gender probability for one first name
capability.description: Queries Genderize.io with one name parameter and returns the provider's aggregate gender, probability, and count estimate in the shared JSON envelope. It is a population-level name estimate, not a person's verified identity attribute.
capability.problem_space: Aggregate first-name gender probability estimation; not identity verification, self-identification inference, personal profiling, or demographic fact retrieval.

constraint.io_signature: Input: one name query at CLI position 1. Output: shared JSON envelope containing Genderize estimate, URL, and HTTP status. HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.
accepted_inputs: one first-name string for the Genderize name query
constraint.output_shape: HTTP 2xx/3xx: {status: "success", tool: string, url: string, http_status: integer, result: object|string}. HTTP 4xx/5xx: {status: "error", tool: string, url: string, http_status: integer, result: object|string}, exit 1. Request exception: {status: "error", tool: string, message: string}, exit 1.
limitations: fixed GET https://api.genderize.io/ with query name=<argument>
no country filter, batch names, confidence threshold, identity lookup, pagination, or other query input; all CLI arguments after position 1 are ignored
wrapper does not locally interpret, validate, paginate, or truncate the provider estimate
missing input is not validated and the name parameter is omitted
probabilities are aggregate estimates, not individual facts
HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.

output_contract.description: Shared JSON envelope containing Genderize aggregate gender, probability, count estimate, URL, and HTTP status.

intent_tags: estimate gender probability from a first name
negative_intents: verify or infer an individual's gender identity
identify a person or retrieve a personal profile

output_contract.description: Shared JSON envelope containing Genderize aggregate gender, probability, count estimate, URL, and HTTP status.
